config.capacity_law: Hypothetical instantaneous equilibrium C_total=beta*C_free in lumen only. Same free inlet, diffusivity, consumption and wall law. No actual carrier, viscosity, affinity, kinetics or toxicity is modeled.
config.model: steady one-sided planar slab at each axial station; finite-volume Michaelis-Menten reaction-diffusion, finite wall transfer, backward-Euler lumen depletion
config.name: PF0 planar perfused-tissue transport screen
config.scope: 144 main cases; synthetic computational feasibility screening only; no human or tissue experiment, injectable product, clinical efficacy or whole-body viability claim.

source_parameters.provenance: Bonart et al. 2026 illustrative liver-like high-demand case; not measured skin physiology.

config.wall_provenance: 0.05 and 0.2 mm/s span the paper's reference range; 0.005 mm/s is an analyst-selected low-transfer stress case.

status: local pre-run freeze, not externally witnessed preregistration
